reference.observation: Unmodified public Tree with local/shared prefixCls in normal/nested/reset scopes; expanded/selected/checked, mixed/disabled, line/leaf icons, block/filter/strict/multiple/nonselectable, aliases/cssVar and style. Shared CSS metrics retain existing Native button/checkbox outer semantics, roving tree focus and nonvirtual layout boundaries. Source focus surface and Native role=tree retain their existing APIs; root/title and focus are retained. Raw Tree.style internal-list placement is separate from nativeRoot public styles.root counterparts for the existing Native outer-root style contract, after all raw/live captures. Source token marker and common Row selectors are independent of local Tree namespace; Raw selectable=false drops the supplied initial selection; nativeSelection separately uses public selectable=true and selectable=false on every node to render the existing Native readonly selection, after all raw/live captures. This is a visual counterpart, not a claim of complete selection semantics parity. TreeSelect keeps its existing canonical internal CSS adapter pending its own prefix migration.
